column1: # Where heroes are recruited (§5.3). building: the hosting building (buildings.csv).
# gender: m / f. chance: probability that a slot has a candidate at all (the music house is rare).
# slots: candidates per refresh at building level 1 (more with levels
# emphasis: attributes of which one is always rolled near its maximum.
# stunt: a random attribute may go up to this (0 = no stunt).
# talentMin / talentMax: each attribute's talent (points a level) at least / at most this (empty: no bound); the
# music house spreads evenly (user 2026-10-21: "女英雄天赋分配更平均一些。每维至少+1，至多+3。").
